QuestInfo.name: [FriendStory] The Healing Process 1
QuestInfo.0: Francis believes that his lovesickness is life-threatening. He needs someone to take care of him.
QuestInfo.1: Francis is requesting medicine for his illness. He will take anything he can get. Go ask Elwin what medicine would be the best.
